newsitem.title: UK: IGC raises 1996 world wheat crop estimate slightly.
newsitem.headline: IGC raises 1996 world wheat crop estimate slightly.

text.p: The International Grains Council on Thursday raised its estimate for 1996 world wheat production to a rounded 581 million tonnes, from a previous estimate in January of slightly over 580 million tonnes.
The change is wholly a result of revised estimates for Australia and the smaller CIS countries.

Rounding makes the jump look bigger than it is. The actual estimate is 580.6 million tonnes, against January's 580.4 million. The estimate for Australian production was raised by 500,000 tonnes to 23.5 million. But a fall for "other CIS" (the former USSR except the Baltic states, Kazakhstan, Russia and Ukraine) by 300,000 tonnes to 6.2 million tonnes offsets much of Australia's rise.
There were no other changes to IGC national production estimates.
